name: ari
description: ari — run an Ariadne (.ari) UI document in the terminal. `ari run doc.ari` takes over the terminal through libcvc's FTXUI backend (keyboard, mouse, floating windows, menus, text entry, half-block images); `ari snapshot` prints a frame as text for CI and docs; `ari check` loads a document and reports its warnings. GL-free: no window, VTK or ImGui.

name: assimp
description: Open Asset Import Library (assimp) — a portable library to import and export a wide variety of 3D model/scene/mesh file formats through a single uniform data structure.  Provides geometry and mesh I/O.  Uses the cvcpkg zlib; other contrib dependencies (rapidjson, utf8cpp, minizip, poly2tri, etc.) remain vendored/bundled.

name: cvcpkg
description: The cvcpkg CLI as one self-contained executable, bin/cvcpkg: PyInstaller freezes CPython 3.12, cvcpkg, its client extras (remote, builder, signing, validate) and the standard recipe set into a single file that needs no Python on the host.  This is the package the one-line installers (/install.sh, /install.ps1) install, so a registry serves its own build of cvcpkg rather than the GitHub release's.
